How to Hire Qualified BIM Engineers in Dubai

Most BIM hiring mistakes start with a vague job description and end with a CV-only decision. A practical process for hiring BIM engineers in Dubai.

Dubai has a deep pool of AEC professionals, and a long list of CVs that mention Revit. The difficulty is not finding candidates; it is telling which of them can do the work your project needs. This is the process we recommend, whether you hire directly or through a staffing partner.

1. Define the role by output, not by title

“BIM engineer” covers modelers, coordinators and discipline specialists. Write down what the person will produce in the first three months: MEP coordination models to LOD 350, shop drawings, clash reports, or families. Then list the software, the discipline and the standards (your BEP, naming rules, authority requirements) they must work to.

2. Separate mandatory from preferred

Mandatory criteria are the ones without which the person cannot do the job: for example Revit MEP and Navisworks for an MEP coordinator. Preferred criteria, such as experience on a similar building type, rank candidates who already pass. Mixing the two leads to good candidates being rejected and weak ones shortlisted.

3. Test skills directly

A conversation about Revit tells you little. A short practical task tells you a lot: give the candidate a small model, a standard to follow and a coordination problem, and review what they produce within a time limit. Our technical assessment uses this approach alongside a software test and a discipline interview.

4. Check experience claims

Ask for the projects, the role on each and the LOD they modelled to, then check with a former manager. Portfolio samples help where the candidate is allowed to share them.

5. Interview for coordination judgement

Good BIM engineers know which clashes matter and how to propose a fix the other trades accept. Ask how they would resolve a specific conflict between a duct, a beam and a sprinkler main, and listen for the order they would work in.

6. Plan mobilization before the offer

Notice periods, visa status, licences, CDE access and site induction decide when the person becomes productive. Agree a dated mobilization plan with named owners, and review output at the end of the first week.

When to use a staffing partner

If you need several engineers quickly, need them only for a phase, or cannot run technical assessments in-house, a BIM staffing partner can shortlist assessed professionals and show the evidence behind each match. You should still interview before committing.
